summary: Learn warehouse licensing, stock reconciliation and lender collateral controls. Explore practical tools for stronger commodity receipt oversight.
lede: Warehouse receipt systems training explains how stored commodities are documented and verified when used as collateral. It is for warehouse operators, agricultural lenders and commodity-market officials who need to coordinate custody controls, assess grading evidence, reconcile receipts with stock records, verify collateral and handle exceptions, including issues involving digital records.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who operate, finance or oversee commodity storage and warehouse receipt arrangements. It suits people who need to verify stock, coordinate control responsibilities or act on receipt-related exceptions.
modules: UNCITRAL Model Law and System Design
prerequisites: Working familiarity with commodity storage, agricultural lending, cooperative finance or agricultural market operations is expected. No coding or programming is required.
